# ForLoopBegin

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Start a loop that processes each item in an array. The scope body is wrapped in a group node. Outputs are set by the executor during iteration.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/for-loop-begin",
  "type": "ForLoopBeginOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/for-loop-begin').par.data` (an input) and `op('/for-loop-begin').out.item` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.data`, `out.item`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

|------|------|---------|
| `data` | `DataField` | `[]` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs
